title: Applied Case Studies and Failure Analysis

lessons.title: Case studies
lessons.body: Real incidents: completion loops (13x retry burn), shadow plans counted as savings, blanket approval keys, silent module pruning.

lessons.title: Failure analysis method
lessons.body: Fingerprint the failure, check negative knowledge, form ONE recovery hypothesis, verify.

lessons.title: Anti-patterns
lessons.body: Phantom success, habitual approvals, unowned completion, unmeasured 'savings'.

lab.goal: Diagnose a seeded failure transcript using the method.
steps: Read docs/case-studies.md in the university content.
For each transcript, name the anti-pattern and the guard that now prevents it.
lab.expect: You can map each historical incident to its v0.4 guard.

task.intro: Answer the scenario questions; the engine verifies them deterministically in a disposable fixture. Your answers are never executed as commands.

questions.q: A research answer is plausible but stale. What is required?
questions.why: External live evidence and a factual referee are required.

questions.q: A worker claims blocked before testing alternatives. Verdict? (escalate/continue)
questions.why: Bounded useful recovery remains: continue or refute the false block.

questions.q: A model endpoint is healthy but never exercised for decisions. Proven?
questions.why: Untested decision paths are not proven by health alone.

executable.task: Produce a failure-analysis card with evidence and a bounded correction.

check.question: Q: Which v0.4 feature prevents completion-retry loops?

troubleshooting: Case studies use synthetic or redacted transcripts only.
Every guard maps to a test in the suite.
